n4_bound.note: astrophysical environments cannot tilt Lambda beyond ~0.9%/dex (§19)

casimir_over_sphere.note: shielding a cosmological volume is absurd; lab-scale cavities only affect the gap volume (zero-sum, N12)

analytic_steering.note: the '3-4 sigma evolving DE' reading is steered ENTIRELY by analysis choices (anchor, z-cut, step) — which is why dr3_plan.json pre-registers the cuts
